cards.note: Already an npm package with a self-contained dsh.bundle patch layer; the README now documents the single official install path (`dsh plugin --profile web add`), and no repository-plugin source list or .dsh-plugin manifest exists to retire.
No legacy dshClient field and no dsh.plugin.json; the client half already declares dsh.client with platform web.
dsh.client declares platform web plus the ./client export the scan requires, so the client half is composed by client-modules instead of being dropped from the roster.
Every service the client half touches (slots, locale) is declared in inject; the undeclared betterLocale ctx.get that strict injection would reject was retired with the language-pack migration.
The optional host service was already probed weakly through ctx.get (never a property read or hard inject entry) and is now retired entirely, so no weak read remains to convert.
The plugin subscribes to no session/event stream and derives no state from event fields; session state arrives through the framework useChat seat.
Not a self-rendering client: the plugin is a slot occupant receiving the session/chat seats as props, so no Node-half aggregation route or plugin-owned /state endpoint is needed.
No tasks.peek/tasks.read tailing; the host half registers nothing and reads no run output.
None of httpServer, tasks or onTaskDone is injected, called or listened on by either half.
No ImageAttachmentRef, read_image output or persisted image metadata anywhere in the plugin.
read_image is not one of the grouped tools, and nothing registers, wraps, parses or snapshot-tests its <content> output.
No custom LLM adapter, image request interceptor, or attachment/upload cache.
No APIProxy or ctx.connection.api call site; the browser half issues no Remote call and the host half is an empty-apply stub.
The plugin produces no persisted SessionEvents; the version-restored ignorable semantics (A2-01) have nothing to apply to.

The removed per-session conversation-node read (session-store chat slice plus the conversationContextKey value import) is replaced by the Chat target's useChat seat with an order + keyed-node lookup by call id.
No launcher wrapper, ACP/Python-SDK integration, or hardcoded profile/user directory; the package is composed by the official profile loader.
No process supervision and no stdout/stderr parsing in the plugin.
No presentation-mode, PTC preset or dispatch-waterfall usage; the plugin only contributes a keyed toolview.
No permission, approval, WebFetch policy or audit registration; the plugin draws tool rows and nothing else.
No custom loopback HTTP/WS/RPC route or browser page; the browser half is served by the host's own client-modules route.
Not a model provider plugin and no settings-page login integration.

The local betterLocale override-store shim is retired: the 19 override languages now register their definitions and dictionaries through the public language-pack API (ctx.locale.addLanguage plus per-locale ctx.locale.register), skipping ids a pack already owns.
No subagent orchestration and no provider/model/reasoning-effort/output-cap selection.
Plugin code needs no change; the package-name reporting switch belongs to the deployment's official-adapter privacy review.
No persistent PowerShell/Bash or Windows directory-picker workaround to re-evaluate.
session-log-deepseek is a deployment opt-in the plugin neither configures nor touches.

The acceptance wrapper already takes the launch URL from the runner and reads window.__DSH_BOOT__ rather than hardcoding a root URL, bundle path or log format, so the required-if-hit condition is not met; asserting the package-name entry and fetching its advertised artifact would be an improvement, not a required change.
No userQuestions.registerProvider or structured-question answerer registration.
No agent-preset inference from persisted sessions and no agent-presets roots to probe.
No isTokenDelta import and no first-token/TPS computation.
The package ships a bundle patch layer that inserts only its own row; it does not reuse the dsh-base composition or restate session-telemetry/plugin-inventory config.
No direct @earendil-works/pi-ai dependency or provider/auth import.

The removed client-runtime package is gone from dsh.client.inject, peerDependencies, source imports and comments; the symbols come from dsh-client-ui-chat, dsh-client-ui-conversation, dsh-client-ui-tool, dsh-client-ui-renderer, dsh-client-ui-slots and dsh-client-locale.

The published ./client artifact now self-registers through __ModuleLoader__.load with id equal to the package name, the assembly row name is the bare package name, and the boot manifest keys the entry by that same id.

Session-derived content is no longer read from the removed per-session conversation-node snapshot; the seat reads the Chat target through useChat over ChatSnapshot order + keyed nodes, the per-view durable projection path for a conversation surface.
No composer DOM manipulation (draft injection, history recall, selection operations).

No MarkdownText or fenced CodeBlock render call site in the shipped surface: the row body renders ui-primitives card blocks. A fuller row body that does render MarkdownText must build the required nested labels object at that render point.
No ctx.connection.api.* usage, so there is no history/transcript read to reroute to session/page|follow or plugin-owned host routes.
The plugin constructs no subagent seed/persisted descriptors and asserts no descriptor version.
No IWorkspaces navigation calls (connectWorkspace, startSession, pickDirectory, listDirectory, createDirectory) and no baselinesReady/recentWorkspaces reads.
No third-party persisted SessionEvents are produced, so nothing needs the restored ignorable marker.
No ctx.remote unary calls and no RemoteResult/RemoteError handling in either half.

Peer set recomposed: the removed client-runtime entry and the exact 0.1.0-rc.6 floors are gone, every consumed client package sits on ^0.1.2-alpha.2, and cordis is the rescoped @deepseek-ai/cordis at the required ^4.0.1 floor.
No startup wrapper or CI Node-version workaround to remove; the plugin ships no launcher.
No pluginInventory/list consumption and no strict PluginInventorySnapshot validation.
No host.describe call and no ctx.remote.$host read; the seat's cwd/home arrive as owner props, and reconnect reactions are not needed.
The plugin is a single package row, not a self-composed profile mounting dsh-tool-todo/dsh-agent/... individually; the shipped bundle already mounts session-projection.
No ctx.settings.register/update/get and no settings namespace, so the compile-time SettingsNamespaceInput change has nothing to migrate.
